name: Enraged Spirits
objectiveText: Bring 8 Smoldering Embers from any of the fire elementals in the Charred Vale to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon. Smoldering Embers  ( 8 )

comments.body: You must have lucked out, because I've been at it for about three hours total, and I've currently got four. I always hear Sida's Bag has a terrible drop rate and both of my characters got it first kill. I guess this is payback for that...

The drop rate for the embers in this quest are stupidly rare... Be prepared to run around killing a bunch of fire elementals, which in themselves are a pain to kill due to being spread around with all the harpies :

You can find fire elementals on the path down to the Charred Vale, or in the vale itself. The ones on the path are lower level (about 23) while those in the vale were 26-27.

Drop rate was pretty good, about one per two kills, maybe a little better.
This one became available after completing the Covert Ops quests.

Since I last did this quest, it appears to me that the drop rate has been increased. Don't neglect the two Fire Elementals outside the entrance to the Charred Vale near Mirkfallon Lake. They dropped two embers for me on the way into the Vale and another two on the way out, which is almost like a 200% rate.

The higher-level (27) Fire Destroyers near the Southern part of the Vale dropped nothing. Not even copper. Nada, and I killed each of them about three times as they respawn quickly. Just ignore them. The rate seems to increase as you head North through the Vale.

My 25 Druid got 2100XP and 20 Silver. Not bad for the level of difficulty.

The droprate is still really bad, and it appears there's at most 5-6 in the zone at the same time. I've run up and down the path and a little bit into the vale like 100 times now and I'm at 5/8. 

I thought the harpies was bad; this is even worse. 

2h and counting.
The charred vale is west of Mirkfallon Lake down the path. In Stonetalon Mountains

I was able to get the Fire Embers in about 15 min. Just stick to this area 35, 57 and you should be good. Just keep running up and down that path and you  will find enough elementals to complete with quest.

Droprate is indeed very bad.

comments.body: Despite what people are saying the drop rate has not increased. I've put about 5 hours into this quest and so far I have 4 out of 8. The flame spirits usually drop nothing at all so don't pick up this quest. It is a total waste of time. Blizzard really knows how to suck it up on a lot of things lately.

FYI: You must complete "Covert Ops - Alpha" & "Covert Ops - Beta" which gets you "Kaela's Update" which unlocks this quest.

I tried to access this one before I finished the quests for Gaxim and I was not able to obtain it.  I am a lev 32 Hunter, BTW so the level requirement wasn't an issue.

The Fire Elementals (called Rogue Flame Spirits) are immune to fire based attacks (duh) so if you are a Mage use cold or arcane based attacks to kill the Rogue Flame Spirits.

You can also make good use of the spell Fire Ward on this quest too.

[Classic] Annoyingly, the elementals are spread throughout the vale and mixed in with all the other enemies there - basilisks, harpies and chimaera. If you've been questing in Stonetalon already you'll likely have more quests to kill other enemies in the vale, so if you combine the quests it's not really an issue. Drop rate was reasonable for me. As with most quests similar to this, the higher level enemies (which are found towards the southern border of the charred vale) likely have a better drop rate.

The enemies for this quest also drop the valuable [item=7068] which can sell for a couple of gold on the AH. Consequently, you'll probably stumble on some competition including higher level players - so watch your back on a PvP server.
